purpose: Teach: バイヤー/打診/催促/充て/固める/アシスト/前文/一筋

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外、本気で、絶対、バイヤー、絶対、と、絶対、研究、絶対、紹介、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Ren — I need you to seriously pursue those overseas buyer contacts. Research and introductions. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Firm weight on key imperatives. Not raising volume, but raising stakes. The tone of someone used to being listened to, who trusts you'll follow through.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。教授より、本気で、絶対、共同研究、絶対、打診、絶対、いただきました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The professor did sound us out about a joint research opportunity. I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Formal and precise. Slight breath before the gratitude — acknowledging the weight of what was offered. Respectful distance maintained. Not effusive, but genuinely moved.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の締切、本気で、絶対、催促、絶対、しなくていいよう、絶対、頼むぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Good. Make sure you stay ahead of the paper deadline so I don't have to chase you on it. That's the favour I'm asking.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, almost wry. Light pressure — not a threat, a reminder. Leans on 'I shouldn't have to ask' without saying it. Manages through expectation, not fear.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費、本気で、絶対、機材購入に、絶対、充てる、絶対、予定です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm planning to allocate the research funds toward equipment purchases. Thank you for making that possible.
lines.style: Careful and deliberate. Showing the plan is already in motion. Gratitude lands quietly but sincerely — not performance, but acknowledgment of what was risked on him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 研究の仮説、本気で、絶対、固める、絶対、よう、絶対、進めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Right. So solidify your research hypothesis and move forward with it. That's what I need from you.
lines.style: Straightforward, expectant. No decoration. The rhythm of someone who's given the scaffolding and now wants to see movement. Confidence underneath the directive.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。後輩の研究、本気で、絶対、アシスト、絶対、しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm actively helping my junior with their research. I want to make sure that's taken care of too.
lines.style: Eager to show competence beyond his own work. Slight rush in the delivery — wanting Hiroshi to see he's thinking beyond himself. Genuine investment, not just duty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文の、本気で、絶対、前文、絶対、教授に、絶対、確認、絶対、いただけ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Yes. I'll check the paper's introduction with the professor to make sure it meets the standard. I'm asking their guidance on this.
lines.style: Methodical and thorough. Building trust through specificity — showing the steps he's taking. Respectful deference to the professor's judgment. Steady, no shortcuts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。私、本気で、絶対、研究に、絶対、一筋に、絶対、取り組んでまいります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'm going to dedicate myself fully to this research. Thank you for believing in me.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The closer — a small steadying breath before the final commitment. This is the moment where he stops listing actions and states his stance. Sincere, not rehearsed. Gratitude that lands because it's real.
